benefits.name: Priority Pass Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass membership with access to 1,300+ participating airport lounges worldwide; a per-visit fee applies.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Pay-as-you-go: per-visit fees apply to the cardholder and guests; current rates at prioritypass.com/wellsfargosignify.

benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Membership is free but lounge visits are not.

benefits.name: MasterRental Insurance / Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage worldwide for physical damage and theft of a rental vehicle paid with the card, up to the lesser of repair cost or the vehicle's wholesale market value.
benefits.terms: Rental periods up to 31 consecutive days. Loss-of-use up to $500 per incident. Includes personal effects coverage up to $1,000 per covered person / $2,000 per rental period.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $250,000 per account of common carrier travel accident coverage when the ticket is purchased with the card.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $300 per covered traveler per trip for essential purchases when checked baggage is not delivered within 4 hours of arrival.

earningRates.terms: Unlimited 2% cash rewards on business purchases, no caps or categories. Excludes cash advances, money orders, prepaid gift cards, wire transfers, fees and gambling transactions.
